description: Resolution playbooks: cause -> ordered step keys. Step definitions carry owner, dependencies, deadlines, required documents and the document type KARM must generate. NYAYA re-validates ordering and may block steps.

REACTIVATE_DORMANT_ACCOUNT.action: Reactivate dormant account (small deposit/withdrawal + fresh KYC at branch)
REACTIVATE_DORMANT_ACCOUNT.action_hi: डोरमेंट खाता फिर से सक्रिय करें (छोटी जमा/निकासी + केवाईसी)
REACTIVATE_DORMANT_ACCOUNT.notes: A dormant account is reactivatable — do NOT close it. A single customer-initiated transaction plus KYC restores it.
REACTIVATE_DORMANT_ACCOUNT.completion_condition: One customer-initiated transaction posted on the account + KYC accepted at the branch (passbook/mini-statement shows the entry).

OLD_ACCOUNT_ACTION.action: Obtain closure/status confirmation from old mapped branch and request return of bounced credits
OLD_ACCOUNT_ACTION.action_hi: पुरानी शाखा से खाता स्थिति पुष्टि और लौटे भुगतान की वापसी का अनुरोध
OLD_ACCOUNT_ACTION.notes: Only when the account is genuinely closed.
OLD_ACCOUNT_ACTION.completion_condition: Written status confirmation from the old branch received, and any bounced credits traced with the return reference.

BANK_NAME_CORRECTION.action: Correct beneficiary name in bank records to match Aadhaar (KYC name correction)
BANK_NAME_CORRECTION.action_hi: बैंक रिकॉर्ड में नाम सुधार (आधार के अनुसार)
BANK_NAME_CORRECTION.notes: B06 rule: seeding is rejected while the name mismatch exists. This MUST complete before re-seeding.
BANK_NAME_CORRECTION.completion_condition: Bank confirms the KYC name in CBS now matches the Aadhaar name character-by-character.

EKYC_COMPLETION.action: Complete scheme eKYC (OTP or face auth at CSC / scheme portal)
EKYC_COMPLETION.completion_condition: Scheme portal shows eKYC status = Completed.

LIFE_CERTIFICATE_SUBMISSION.action: Submit annual life certificate (Jeevan Pramaan) before the 30 November deadline
LIFE_CERTIFICATE_SUBMISSION.action_hi: जीवन प्रमाणपत्र जमा करें (30 नवंबर से पहले)
LIFE_CERTIFICATE_SUBMISSION.notes: Separate stoppage risk — scheduled even when another cause explains the current failure.
LIFE_CERTIFICATE_SUBMISSION.completion_condition: Life certificate acknowledgement received (Jeevan Pramaan ID or bank stamp).

AADHAAR_SEEDING_REQUEST.action: Submit Aadhaar seeding request (Annexure I) at the preferred bank branch to fix the NPCI mapper
AADHAAR_SEEDING_REQUEST.action_hi: बैंक शाखा में आधार सीडिंग (अनुबंध-I) जमा करें
AADHAAR_SEEDING_REQUEST.notes: NPCI validates with UIDAI in 24-48 hours. Ask for the acknowledgement receipt with the seeding request number.
AADHAAR_SEEDING_REQUEST.completion_condition: Seeding acknowledgement receipt with request number received; NPCI mapper flips to 'Enabled for DBT' within 48h–7 days.

VERIFY_MAPPER.action: Verify NPCI mapper now shows 'Enabled for DBT' for the correct account
VERIFY_MAPPER.action_hi: एनपीसीआई मैपर में 'Enabled for DBT' स्थिति की जांच करें
VERIFY_MAPPER.notes: Re-check 48h-7d after seeding. HAQ watchdog performs this check.
VERIFY_MAPPER.completion_condition: NPCI mapper check returns 'Enabled for DBT' pointing to the intended account.

REPROCESS_REQUEST.action: Request scheme department to re-process the failed installments (quote URN)
REPROCESS_REQUEST.action_hi: योजना विभाग से फंसी किस्तों की दोबारा प्रोसेसिंग का अनुरोध (URN के साथ)
REPROCESS_REQUEST.notes: Rejected funds have returned to the government account — they must be re-released.
REPROCESS_REQUEST.completion_condition: Scheme office confirms re-processing with a new credit reference; amount credited to the account.

NON_PAYMENT_CERTIFICATE.action: Obtain non-payment certificate from bank (required by Tahsildar/DSWO for pension arrears)
NON_PAYMENT_CERTIFICATE.action_hi: बैंक से गैर-भुगतान प्रमाणपत्र लें (पेंशन बकाया के लिए आवश्यक)
NON_PAYMENT_CERTIFICATE.notes: Mandatory supporting document for pension arrears claims with the district social welfare office.
NON_PAYMENT_CERTIFICATE.completion_condition: Signed non-payment certificate issued on bank letterhead.

ESCALATE_CPGRAMS.action: File CPGRAMS grievance against the scheme department if unresolved
ESCALATE_CPGRAMS.action_hi: सीपीजीआरएएमएस शिकायत दर्ज करें (समाधान न होने पर)
ESCALATE_CPGRAMS.notes: Auto-prepared by HAQ if the re-processing request is unanswered by T+15.
ESCALATE_CPGRAMS.completion_condition: CPGRAMS grievance filed and DARPG grievance number recorded.

ESCALATE_RTI.action: File RTI to the scheme department asking which account received each credit, date and seeding status
ESCALATE_RTI.action_hi: आरटीआई दायर करें (किस खाते में भुगतान गया — पूरी जानकारी के लिए)
ESCALATE_RTI.notes: Last resort in the ladder: nodal officer -> CPGRAMS -> RTI -> first appeal.
ESCALATE_RTI.completion_condition: RTI application filed with acknowledgment; reply received within 30 days.
